## Checklist

- [ ] All commits are signed off with `git commit -s` ([DCO](https://github.com/tombadilo-bombadilo/budgero/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin) — required, CI enforces it)
- [ ] `pnpm run type-check:all` passes
- [ ] Relevant lint and test gates pass (`lint:core|runtime|app|server`, `test:core|app|server`)
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot
- [ ] Larger changes were discussed in an issue first
